def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[valid_mask] = -remaining[valid_mask]
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_bins = bins >= item
    priorities[valid_bins] = item / bins[valid_bins]
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_bins = bins >= item
    utilization_ratio = (bins[valid_bins] - item) / bins[valid_bins]
    priorities[valid_bins] = -utilization_ratio  # Negative to prioritize lower utilization
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.where(valid, -remaining, 0)
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """

    valid_bins = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid_bins] = -remaining_capacity[valid_bins]
    return priority_scores
